dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。相談していいですか？
dialogue.content: Hello. It's nice to meet you too. May I talk to you about something?

dialogue.origin: はい。大丈夫です。すみませんが先に性別・年齢・お住いの地域をおしえていただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, of course. Excuse me, but before we begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and the area where you live?

dialogue.origin: 女性、44歳、滋賀県です。
dialogue.content: I'm a 44-year-old woman, and I live in Shiga Prefecture.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日はどういったご相談内容でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 近くに住む実家の父が持病で母が介護中なのですが、2人でいるので心配なのです。私も仕事してるので昼間あまり協力出来ないのです。
dialogue.content: My father, who lives nearby at my parents' house, has a chronic illness and my mother is caring for him. I'm worried because it's just the two of them. I also have a job, so I can't help much during the day.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは気にかかりますよね。どういった点で心配されているのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be a concern for you. What specifically are you worried about?

dialogue.origin: 母はなるべく自分で頑張る人だからあまり助けて欲しいと言わないし、最近疲れている様子が気がかりです。
dialogue.content: My mother is the type of person who tries to do everything herself, so she doesn't ask for help much. I'm concerned because she seems tired lately.

dialogue.origin: あまり寝れてないようなんです。
dialogue.content: It seems like she's not getting much sleep.

dialogue.origin: お母さまはお父様のことをしっかり介護されているのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like your mother is taking very good care of your father.

dialogue.origin: お母さまがあまり眠れていないとのことですが、いつぐらいからかわかりますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your mother isn't sleeping well. Do you know about when that started?

dialogue.origin: 1人で負担し過ぎと思うくらいです。少し自分の時間も持って欲しいのですが、大丈夫って言うんです。１ヶ月前くらいから夜に父が起きて、そこから寝ないみたいです
dialogue.content: I think she's taking on too much by herself. I wish she would take some time for herself, but she just says she's fine. For about a month now, my father has been waking up at night and doesn't go back to sleep.

dialogue.origin: 一か月もなかなか眠れていないのは周りからみても、大丈夫かなと心配になりますよね。
dialogue.content: Not being able to sleep well for a whole month would make anyone concerned for her well-being.

dialogue.origin: 姉が、最近母が疲れてると言ってまして。父は昼間に寝るからいいのですが、母はその時間が自分が動ける時間だからと私達のご飯作ったり掃除したりして寝ないです。
dialogue.content: My sister mentioned that our mother seems tired lately. My father sleeps during the day, which is fine, but my mother uses that time as her chance to get things done, like making meals for the family or cleaning, so she doesn't get any rest.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お父様が休まれている間にほかの家事もされているんですね。何人で一緒に住んでらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So while your father is resting, she’s also doing other housework. How many people are living together?

dialogue.origin: 特殊かもですが、実家は両親で近くに姉家族4人、私家族2人、私達は仕事してるからと夜ご飯は母がまとめて作ってくれて子供に実家で食べさせてくれています。
dialogue.content: This might be a bit unusual, but my parents live at the family home, and nearby are my sister’s family of four and my own family of two. Since we both work, my mother cooks dinner for everyone and has the children eat at my parents’ place.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。近くに住んでらっしゃるのですね。だからこそお母さまの力になりたいと思ってらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You live close by. That must be why you feel so strongly about wanting to help your mother.

dialogue.origin: はい。姉は仕事が21時とかになって責任ある立場だから厳しいと思うし、私がもう少し出来たら。
dialogue.content: Yes. My sister has a responsible position and often works until 9 p.m., so I think it's difficult for her. I wish I could do more.

dialogue.origin: 母にとってはご飯作るのも気分転換らしいので、適当でいいと言ってもしっかり8人分作ります。
dialogue.content: Apparently, cooking is a way for my mother to unwind, so even if we tell her to just make something simple, she still properly cooks for all eight of us.

dialogue.origin: お姉様は遅くまで仕事されているのですね。お母様は家族のためによく動いてくださっているのですね。今、お母様を手伝えそうなことって何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Your sister works late, I see. Your mother does so much for the family. Is there anything you feel you could do to help your mother right now?

dialogue.origin: 父は昼間は大丈夫みたいで、夜になると心が不安になって起きるようです。夜に預けられるところを探してますが、母がなかなか納得しないので私が泊まりに行って一緒に見てます。
dialogue.content: My father seems fine during the day, but at night he gets anxious and wakes up. I’m looking for a place that can take him overnight, but my mother is reluctant to agree, so I've been staying over to help watch him.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に夜泊まりにいっているのですね。仕事もあるのに、がんばっていらっしゃいますね。お母さまはお父様を預けるのに納得されないのはどうしてですか？
dialogue.content: So you're staying over at night with them. You're working so hard, especially with your own job. Why do you think your mother is reluctant to have your father stay somewhere else?

dialogue.origin: 母は昼間になって落ち着くとみれそうな気がするみたいです。納得しないと泊まりのケアサービスを相談出来ないから話すのですが、言い方が悪いのかうまくいかないです
dialogue.content: It seems that when daytime comes and things calm down, she feels like she can manage. I try to talk to her because we can't arrange for overnight care services unless she agrees, but maybe I'm saying it the wrong way, because it never goes well.

dialogue.origin: うまく伝わらないと歯がゆいですよね。その話をどういった時にお母様にお話しされていますか？
dialogue.content: It must be frustrating when you can't get your point across. When do you usually talk to your mother about this?

dialogue.origin: 父が寝なかった時の朝とかです。1人じゃ見れないよ！とか、頑張ってるのを知ってるのに冷たい言い方しか出来なくてもう少し言い方あったかなと悩みます。でも母が寝れていないのが心配です。
dialogue.content: In the mornings after my father hasn't slept, for example. I end up saying harsh things like, 'You can't handle this alone!' Even though I know she's trying her best, I can only say it in a cold way, and I worry if there was a better way to put it. But I'm just so concerned that she isn't sleeping.

dialogue.origin: お母様が頑張っているのを理解されているからこそ、悩んでしまいますよね。お母様はほかにはお体に何か症状とかはないですか？
dialogue.content: It's precisely because you understand how hard your mother is working that you're so troubled. Does your mother have any other physical symptoms?

dialogue.origin: 身体は3時間集中して寝たら大丈夫と言いますが、夜中に起こされたらイラつくみたいで父に怒ることが多いです。
dialogue.content: She says that if she can get three hours of solid sleep she’s fine, but when she’s woken up in the middle of the night she gets irritable and often snaps at my father.

dialogue.origin: 夜中に起こされたらいらついてしまいますね。睡眠３時間で生活されているのは本当に体が心配ですね。
dialogue.content: It’s understandable to feel irritable when woken in the middle of the night. Living on three hours of sleep is really concerning for her health.

dialogue.origin: この前も訪問サービスの方を夜中に3日連続呼ぶことになったので、さすがに母も少し考えたみたいです。それは訪問サービスの方が話してくださいました
dialogue.content: The other day, we had to call the in-home care service in the middle of the night for three days in a row, so it seems even my mother gave it some thought. The person from the service told me that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そのお母さまが考えられていたことをお聞きになりましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Did you hear what your mother was thinking about?

dialogue.origin: ずっと起きるのが続くと周りにも迷惑かけるかなと。自分もイライラしてる自覚はあるようです。
dialogue.content: She was worried that if he kept waking up constantly, it would become a burden on others. She also seems to be aware that she herself is irritable.

dialogue.origin: それを聞いてどう思われました？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.origin: 少し変わってくれたのかな？と思います。宿泊だと金銭的に高いこともネックで納得しなかったみたいですが、倒れたらどうしようもないからと私も言いました。
dialogue.content: I think maybe she's starting to change a little. The high cost of overnight care was a sticking point and why she didn't agree, but I told her that if she collapses, there's nothing we can do.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お母様に自分の思いを伝えられたのですね。お母様はどうおっしゃられていましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you were able to convey your feelings to your mother. What did she say?

dialogue.origin: ２日後の病院終わったら1度考えてみるとは言ってました
dialogue.content: She said she would think about it after her hospital appointment in two days.

dialogue.origin: 思いを伝えて少し変化があったのですね。それはうれしいことですね。何かほかにお母様の手助けをすることとか考えてらっしゃるのですか？までです。本当にありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: It sounds like there was a small change after you shared your feelings. That's great to hear. Are you thinking of any other ways to help your mother? That's all from me for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

topic.sub: 母の介護による疲労とその対処方法
